title: Blisters
claims: Most blisters heal on their own within about a week and usually do not need a GP appointment.
NHS advises keeping a blister clean, covering it with a soft plaster or padded dressing, and not bursting it yourself.
Friction from poorly fitting shoes is a common cause of foot blisters; moist skin and warm conditions make them more likely.
